release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.44.0 is a coordinated reliability and UI hardening release. Classic Top Tabs now adapt cleanly on narrower windows by preserving readable labels and moving lower-priority destinations into a More menu instead of cramming or wrapping navigation. Task Manager V2 Fleet Control is normalized as one global Tasks-level control surface rather than appearing module-specific. Private-beta device approval errors are clearer and surface the installation identity needed for support without weakening one-device enforcement. The release also expands regression coverage for responsive navigation, global Fleet placement, four-retailer Task Studio switching, support and backup checks, and the 120-task browser soak while retaining the v0.43.2 update modal and protected 14-day offline license lease.
